description: Labelled prompt pairs for choosing a semantic cache threshold. `same` is true when one request may be answered from the other's cached response, and false when it may not. The negatives are deliberately hard: pairs that share almost every word and mean different things are the ones a threshold has to separate, and a set made only of obviously unrelated pairs would certify any threshold at all.
